# Validation record

Frozen source snapshot: `dc4d7aef51cd863275ed64a11bf3b131d1d66d26`, branch `claude/stoic-davinci-ktysg2`.

## Manuscripts

The repository word-count script was run afresh on all 18 preserved manuscript tracks. All ten developed manuscripts are within 6,000 words under its strict count. The basic repository manuscript scan also passed for all ten. The manifest records exact counts, source blob identities, local SHA-256 values, and scan output. These are mechanical checks, not proof of anonymity under every possible inference or of prize eligibility.

This pass did not rerun the authors' mathematical validation programs or independently reproduce their proofs. Existing validation claims in the essays and methodology reports remain attributed to the recorded authoring work. Literature novelty, philosophical adequacy, and contest provenance remain subject to the stated unresolved issues.

## PDFs

Five essay reading copies and five corresponding methodology PDFs were compiled with Pandoc and XeLaTeX. The final compilation completed without warnings. An explicit Unicode mapping repaired the proof-ending square in the typesetting layer; the manuscript text was not substantively edited.

All 85 pages were rendered. Contact sheets for all ten PDFs were visually inspected, with additional full-page checks of mathematical text and a regret table. Automated text-block bounds checks found no text blocks within 15 points of a page edge. The resulting documents have consistent margins, readable equations, and no observed clipping. PDF author and title metadata fields are empty; generic LaTeX/Pandoc creator metadata remains.

## Methodology and limits

Ten methodology reports were prepared from the available repository record. Model/version and cost gaps are explicit. The reports disclose human participation and the external OpenAI context-exposure concern, and distinguish the recorded Claude clean-start workflow from a new independent audit. They are review drafts and must track the actual final revision and selection before submission.

No new candidate pool was generated, no philosophical claim was silently repaired, no current referee verdict was invented, and no contest entry was submitted. Source-copy normalization may affect a terminal newline; original Git blob identities and local file hashes are separately recorded.

The package contains review documents and private selection records. Only the selected essay and its finalized methodology report belong in a contest submission, subject to the contest's actual form requirements.
